title: Migrate LLM event export records from TypedDict to dataclasses
description:
Replace the LLM event export records in `schemas/game_export_types.py` with dataclasses: `LlmUsage`, `GameStartEvent`, `LlmResponseEvent`, `ToolCallEvent`, `StallEvent`, `ContextResetEvent`, `ContextTrimEvent`, `LlmErrorEvent`, and `AutoPilotModeEvent`. Fold `_LlmEventBase` into this migration as part of the same hierarchy.

Update the union and the direct event-processing consumers in export generation, leaderboard code, and analysis tools. Keep `GameExport` / `BuiltGameExport` container migration out of this PR.

This should be one coherent event-layer migration, not multiple tiny PRs for each event subtype.
